children: UK brick manufacturer's H1 revenue fell 9.5% amid challenging construction markets
Adjusted EPS for H1 rose 0.9% as gross margin improved to 37%
Company maintained interim dividend and expects full-year performance within expectations
Michelmersh Brick expects FY26 performance within full-year market expectations
Company sees resilient order intake, but timing of call-offs remains challenging
Michelmersh Brick expects H2 operational cash flow to improve net debt position
MARKET DEMAND WEAKNESS - Co said revenue fell due to ongoing demand challenges in UK construction, especially London and South East
EFFICIENCY AND REORGANISATION - Margin improvement attributed to operational cadence and reorganisation activities
ORDER INTAKE AHEAD OF PRODUCTION - Order intake tracked ahead of manufacturing volumes, but inconsistent call-off rates reflect customer uncertainty
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction materials peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Michelmersh Brick Holdings PLC is GBp108.00, about 45% above its August 28 closing price of GBp74.50
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
